title: The router and the mixture-of-experts layer (NF-1T)
note: NR1-NR14: too many or no experts selected, an index out of range, unnormalised gates, a non-finite score hidden, a capacity overflow kept, padding routed, the load-balancing loss misweighted, a feature's identity, dimension or missingness lost in the embedding, a bounded head unbounded, the attention mask ignored, tensors initialised alike.

mutations.name: NR1_router_selects_too_many
mutations.rationale: each token routed to one expert more than top_k

mutations.name: NR2_router_selects_none
mutations.rationale: the router selects no expert, so every token skips the routed experts and each MoE layer silently becomes the identity

mutations.name: NR3_invalid_expert_index
mutations.rationale: indices shifted past the last expert

mutations.name: NR4_gates_not_normalised
mutations.rationale: selected weights no longer sum to one

mutations.name: NR8_aux_loss_unscaled
mutations.rationale: the load-balancing term without its expert-count scale

mutations.name: NR9_feature_identity_dropped_in_embedding
mutations.rationale: the network no longer sees which feature a token is

mutations.name: NR10_dimension_dropped_in_embedding
mutations.rationale: the network no longer sees a token's dimension

mutations.name: NR11_missing_value_leaks
mutations.rationale: a MISSING token's channels reach the network

mutations.name: NR13_attention_mask_ignored
mutations.find: scores = jnp.where(mask[:, None, None, :], scores, NEG_INF)

mutations.name: NR14_tensors_initialised_alike
mutations.rationale: every tensor of a shape drawn identically
